'''Esoomians''' were hulking humanoids indigenous to [[Esooma]] who bore a strong resemblance to the [[Zexx]]. They reached 3 meters in height and were immensely strong, but tended to be simpleminded and to speak in a garbled manner. They were regarded as among the best hired muscle in the galaxy.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], their homeworld was quarantined by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], however, the quarantine was lifted, and Esoomians began seeking work throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tantor (bounty hunter)|Tantor]] was an Esoomian,<ref name="gg10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> as well as the [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]] [[Tontruk]].<ref name="foi">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
